title: airdress.functions.yaml
description: Which directories of a repository are functions, the Function manifest each deploys with, and the operator it deploys to. Read by `airdress fn deploy`.

layout.description: The version of this file's format.

operator.description: The operator every entry deploys to unless it names its own: an FQDN or an https URL.

path.description: The function directory (function.json and src/), relative to the repository root.

manifest.description: The Function manifest, relative to the repository root. Defaults to function.yaml in the directory.

operator.description: The operator this entry deploys to. Each (manifest, operator) pair appears once.
